Macrons

Consonantal i

Construction, trades & building materials

upright noun

a vertical member

also standard, vertical tube

classical

Vitruvius 2.8.20: arrēctāriōrum et trānsversāriōrum dispositiōne
Vitruvius 7.3.11: in arrēctāriīs et trānsversāriīs
Vitruvius 10.13.4, of the uprights of siege towers
Lewis & Short: “the upright posts of a wall”

arrēctārium, arrēctāriī n.

noun, second declension

upright, standard

Usually plural arrēctāria. In Vitruvius, of the posts of timber-framed walls; applied here to the steel standards of a tube scaffold.

Other words

  • fistula ad perpendiculum posita — upright or vertical tube, literally a tube placed plumb

    also used · our formation

    Our description; the classical member name is arrēctārium. Ancient ad perpendiculum means vertically / perpendicularly.

See also crossbar, scaffold pole, brace, scaffold.

SourcesLewis & Short: arrectarius · Lewis & Short: perpendiculum
